reviews.title: Feature requests fall on deaf ears
reviews.text:
For years I have asked for simple feature requests from Navionics to include the following but my requests have fallen on deaf ears making me think as an end user that Navionics do not value their customers:

1. To allow the name of user waypoints, to be overlaid on the chart like other better apps do instead of just an icon.

2. To identify the source of NMEA depth to show if it is “Depth below keel” or “depth below transducer” (important for navigational safety)

3. To be able to create a route from a list of user waypoints and be able to search and add the waypoints to an existing route.

4. To allow wind angle, wind speed and boat speed fields to be overlaid as NMEA data fields in the app.

All entirely possible but protectionism in the market place and arrogance torwards their customers seems to be preventing them adding these feature

Update - I won’t hold my breath

reviews.title: Stops updating while underway
reviews.text:
I really like this navigation App for the dock to dock routing and ETA using my IPhone in addition to my MFD.  Unfortunately, it stops updating randomly after a few minutes which isn’t always obvious (not what you need when you’re underway and in unfamiliar waters with a lot of boat traffic.  I reported this problem last year and figured they would have fixed it by now since it is a serious issue.  Unfortunately not.  I upgraded my iphone from a SE3 to a new 16e but have the same problem with no difference.  It’s hard to believe that a $50 annual subscription doesn’t buy better software support from a major company such as Garmin.

In 2026, the problem still has not been resolved.  I have determined that the problem is with a SW graphing routine getting hung.  Evidence of this is that the program doesn’t hang on IOS if it is running in the background.  If it is running in the foreground, it will randomly hang during map graphing update.  Garmin says it is a problem with Apple GPS not registering a change due to slow velocity (6 kts is not slow).  I can see how this could be a lawsuit against Garmin since they have not resolved a serious problem that could cause a boat navigation disaster.    For $50/yr, I expect that this serious problem working with IOS would be resolved.  Good thing Garmin has plenty of money for a future lawsuit.

reviews.title: Dangerously unreliable
reviews.text: We have been using this app for over 3 years and it in general has worked well. But in the last 6 months or so the app randomly stops updating our position or freezes altogether. This can happen at the worst possible time - navigating a tricky inlet or shallow anchorage, etc. Restarting the app usually but not always restores normal operation. Fortunately we have a chartplotter and Aquamap as alternatives but not being able to rely on accurate position data makes Navionics Boating a danger to safe navigation. I am not the only one with this problem. YouTubers Sailing Magic Carpet recently reported the same exact issue that we have observed.  The overall quality of Navionics map data is good but the quality of the app itself is unacceptable.
